source.paper: JWST Discovery of Strong Lensing from a Galaxy Cluster at Cosmic Noon: Giant Arcs and a Highly Concentrated Core of XLSSC 122

lcdm_predictions.notes: Standard Lambda-CDM hierarchical assembly models predict clusters at z~2 are young and unrelaxed with low concentration. The high concentration (c_200=6.3) and mature ICL indicate an accelerated early structure formation timeline.

black_hole_universe_prediction.notes: In a universe born from an Einstein-Cartan torsion bounce inside a rotating black hole, early primordial relic seed density accelerates initial collapse, shifting z_coll earlier and resulting in compact, hyper-concentrated dark matter cores at cosmic noon.
